summary: Re-documented step M1-S03 (tested -> documented) in build tier2-webhook after its run-5 repair and retest: re-rendered PLAN.md, appended 1 decision to decisions.md (D-M1S03-12 -- TestDataFactory.cls refreshed to the corrected templates/apex/tests/TestDataFactory.cls, commit 5edcb3281, so a lookup Id is assigned only when the caller supplies one, closing S2-F-12 for this step's copy of the factory). No traceability.md edit: per this pass's own scope, a row changes only when an artefact path changes, and TestDataFactory.cls's path is unchanged from every row that already carries other M1-S03 files -- only its content changed, and no row in traceability.md names TestDataFactory.cls in its artefact_paths cell at all, so there was no row to update. No workbook rows written: scale: feature keeps the ten-section workbook optional (standards/build-orchestration.md section 3.1), and this build has never populated one across six prior documentation passes -- this pass keeps that precedent rather than starting one unilaterally for a single-file content fix. The decision entry also corrects the record on one point: the repair's own envelope (2026-09-12T17-05-00Z.json, finding S5-F-02) and step-tester's retest (2026-09-12T16-51-00Z.json) both flagged M1-S04 as still shipping the pre-fix TestDataFactory.cls copy. Checked this pass against artefacts/M1-S04/deploy-order.md section 0d: M1-S04 was repaired in parallel, closing the identical S2-F-12 finding for its own copy. D-M1S03-12 records that the S5-F-02 observation is superseded, not standing.
confidence_rationale: This pass's own scope was completed cleanly and without ambiguity: one decision recorded, sourced from the step's own envelope and deploy-order.md section 0c, with no artefact left undocumented and no traceability row requiring an edit it did not get. Held to MEDIUM rather than HIGH for two reasons the AGENT_CONTRACT default rubric and this build's own prior M1-S03 documentation pass (2026-09-12T16-35-00Z.json) both weigh the same way: (1) M1-S05's build-level package.xml is still confirmed stale -- it lists the pre-run-4 twelve ApexClass members, not the thirteen (soon fourteen, once M1-S04's manifest needs match) this milestone's Apex steps now ship, unchanged since D-M1S03-11 first named the gap; (2) no Apex test has executed against a real org at any pass of this design-only build, including this one -- the retest that grounds this decision is a byte-identical-diff plus four static checkers at exit 0, not an org-side confirmation that the DmlException on Case.AccountId is actually gone. Both are pre-existing, build-wide facts this pass did not create and could not close from inside its own scope, but an honest confidence score carries them forward rather than reporting HIGH on the strength of a clean documentation pass alone.

process_observations.observation: The repair's own envelope (2026-09-12T17-05-00Z.json) and the retest's (2026-09-12T16-51-00Z.json) already carried every fact this pass needed as a finding (S5-F-01) and a verdict -- this documentation pass required no re-derivation from the raw Apex, only reading the two envelopes and deploy-order.md section 0c.

This pass's own instructions matched the build's established precedent exactly rather than creating a new tension: the workbook stays untouched at scale: feature (six prior passes, zero rows), and no traceability edit was needed because the one changed artefact's path was already unchanged and not itself named in any row's artefact_paths cell.

M1-S05 (build-level package.xml, already documented) was built before either the S2-F-11 or S2-F-12 repairs existed and still lists the pre-run-4 twelve ApexClass members. milestone:M1 was approved on evidence that predates S2-F-06, S2-F-11 and now also S2-F-12.

A stale cross-step observation was caught and corrected in this pass's decision entry rather than left standing: this step's own S5-F-02 finding and step-tester's retest both name M1-S04 as still shipping a pre-fix TestDataFactory.cls copy. M1-S04 was in fact repaired in parallel (artefacts/M1-S04/deploy-order.md section 0d) -- a reader of S5-F-02 or of tests/M1-S03/summary.md alone, without also checking M1-S04's own documentation pass, would carry a false impression of an open gap.

Whether Tier2_Webhook_Admin would need create-FLS on Case.AccountId if a future test legitimately needed the lookup remains untested by this repair (carried from the repair's own envelope, finding S5-F-01/ambiguous) -- the fix removes the unwanted field from the DML request rather than granting FLS for it, which is correct for every call site that exists today but is not itself a statement about a future need.

M1-S05 needs a fresh build to add the TestUserFactory ApexClass member (and, once M1-S04's own manifest needs are confirmed, any member it contributes), and milestone-verifier needs to re-run against a dry run that actually executes tests before the M1 gate's existing approval can be trusted -- open since the run-4 repair's own envelope, neither invoked by this pass.
